responsibility: Implements gm2’s binary-search tree for name-keyed symbol storage. It uses a sentinel root with the real tree hanging from `Left`, supports insertion of unique `NameKey.Name` to symbol (`WORD`) pairs, deletion with subtree splicing, lookup and containment checks, recursive destruction, ordered traversal and conditional traversal callbacks, and filtered node counting, supplying the core scoped-name indexing structure used throughout the symbol table and reserved-word machinery.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file provides the concrete binary-search-tree implementation for SymbolKey, including the sentinel-root layout, `Node` record with `KeyName`/`KeySym`, parent search, insertion, deletion, and recursive traversals; `SymbolKey.def` only specifies that interface.
